Professional biography

Ramtin Mojtahedi

Postdoctoral medical AI researcher working across medical imaging, data-efficient learning, and multimodal clinical prediction.

Biography

Ramtin Mojtahedi is listed as a postdoctoral researcher with the Sage Lab at University Health Network (UHN). His research portfolio focuses on medical artificial intelligence, including medical image segmentation, foundation models, vision transformers, representation learning, radiomics, and multimodal clinical prediction.

Queen’s University’s official Spring 2026 convocation program records his Doctor of Philosophy in Computing, conferred at the June 24, 2026 ceremony under the formal name Ramtin Mojtahedi Saffari, with Amber Simpson listed as supervisor. His Queen’s lab profile documents earlier training in electrical and computer engineering and doctoral research on deep-learning methods for image-segmentation tasks.

Queen’s School of Computing has also documented his 2024 recognition for graduate leadership, community engagement, student support, and contributions to the School’s intellectual and social community.

Name and publication identity

Current scholarly work is published as Ramtin Mojtahedi. Earlier engineering publications also appear under Ramtin Mojtahedi Saffari and R. M. Saffari. The persistent scholarly identifier is ORCID 0000-0002-3953-3256.
